title: Surreal Dreamscape Portal
description: A surreal collage features a raised human hand with black paw print symbols floating above it against a red background. In the center, a glowing pink-purple energy orb emits light and particles, with a sad blue-purple blob creature with large eyes floating nearby. The upper right shows a cracked, melting pale humanoid face with yellow eyes, while the lower right depicts a lonely dirt path through a yellow-green forest with a distant silhouetted figure.
